conclusions.rationale: Integrability at each n does not bound |X_n| by one on the tail event. For U uniform on [0,1], X_n=n 1{U<=1/n} converges to zero in probability but E|X_n|=1.
conclusions.repair: Add uniform integrability with a valid truncation argument, or an explicit common bound that justifies this displayed inequality.
conclusions.counterexample: X_n=n 1{U<=1/n}, with E|X_n|=1 and P(|X_n|>epsilon)=1/n for n>epsilon.
